# Review CHANGES REQUESTED for PAN-5289

# Review — PAN-5289
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — "Reveal in files" never reveals: nothing reads the dock store's `reveal`, so Shift+Enter in Go to file, the Changes-row and diff-view Reveal buttons, and `activeDock.revealFile` only switch to the Files tab

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5289-review-f89f29e9
- Manifest: .pan/review/agent-pan-5289-review-f89f29e9/context.json (acceptanceCriteria empty in manifest; ACs taken from `.pan/drafts/pan-5289.md` §9, requirements §4, work items §8)
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5289 / workspaces/feature-pan-5289
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5328
- HEAD reviewed: f89f29e960675b267cd121828053080ce10b0c38
- Base / prior cycle SHA: merge-base c1547bb94809b635fc6b15ce55f3146dfccb1985; no prior review cycle

## Blocking Findings

### [requirements] "Reveal in files" switches to Files but never reveals or selects the file — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/dock/FilesTab.tsx:33`
- Severity: !
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect, with a matching spec gap (§6.8 names only `scope.revealPath` as the Files tab's reveal input). in_pr_scope: FR-6 (file rows with "Reveal in files"), FR-7 (diff view "Reveal in files") and FR-9 ("Shift+Enter reveals in Files") are explicit commitments of this PR.
- Trigger and changed-code connection: six call sites write `openDock(deckKey, { tab: 'files', reveal: { rootId, path } })`:
  - `DockQuickOpen.tsx:46` (Go to file, Shift+Enter)
  - `changes/ConversationChangesList.tsx:91`, `changes/RootChangesList.tsx:40` and `changes/ProjectMainChangesList.tsx:93` (row Reveal buttons)
  - `changes/DockDiffView.tsx:129` (diff view Reveal)
  - `WorkDock.tsx:156` (`activeDock.revealFile`)

  `workDockStore.openDock` stores `next.reveal` (`workDockStore.ts:153`). No module reads it: `grep -rn "?\.reveal\|\]\.reveal\|state\.reveal"` over `src/` finds no reader. `FilesTab` passes only `scope.revealPath`, which `deriveDockScope` sets only for an active `code` pane (rule 5). So `ExplorerFiles` calls `explorerStore.revealPath` only for the active code pane's file.
- Expected / observed / impact: the expected behavior is that the Files tab expands the file's ancestor folders, selects the file and scrolls to it. Observed (static trace): the dock switches to Files with the tree unchanged, and the requested file stays collapsed and unselected unless it happens to be the active code pane's file. Reveal is a primary navigation action in three surfaces this PR adds (Changes, diff view, Go to file), so the operator clicks Reveal and nothing locates the file.
- Evidence: static trace, plus a grep for readers (none). The unit tests stop at the store write: `ConversationChangesList.test.tsx:153`, `RootChangesList.test.tsx:61` and `WorkDock.test.tsx:229` assert `byDeck[DECK].reveal` and never a selected tree row, so the green suite does not cover the effect. Not reproduced in a browser; the missing reader is unambiguous.
- Fix: consume `reveal` in the Files tab. For example, in `FilesTab` read `byDeck[deckKey].reveal` and `openSeq`; when `reveal.rootId === scope.rootId`, pass `reveal.path` as `ExplorerFiles`'s `revealPath` (it already calls `useExplorerStore.getState().revealPath`). Key the effect on `openSeq` so a second Reveal of the same path still selects it. When `reveal.rootId` differs from `scope.rootId` (Go to file's `deckRootId` fallback), set the root override to `reveal.rootId`, anchored to the active pane, before revealing, or document that case. Add a test that clicks a Reveal and asserts the tree row is selected (`aria-selected`) with its folders expanded. Spec correction: §6.8 should state that the Files tab reveals `store.reveal` as well as `scope.revealPath`.

## Non-blocking Findings

### [correctness] An open diff and a Find-in-folder scope outlive a scope change — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/dock/ChangesTab.tsx:28`
- Severity: ~
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect; in_pr_scope
- Trigger: open a file's diff in the Changes tab for conversation A, then activate another Stage tab (Home, another conversation, an issue). `ChangesTab` renders `DockDiffView` whenever `byDeck[deck].diff` is set, and only `openDock` clears `diff`/`diffList`/`searchPath`. Neither `setTab` nor an active-pane change clears them.
- Impact: the old target renders under the new scope line and against the new `scope.rootId`. For an uncommitted target, `readFile(newRoot, oldPath)` diffs a different checkout's copy (often "No changes" or NOT_FOUND), tagged "not committed", with the old i/N list. Back recovers. `searchPath` similarly keeps a folder scope from the previous root on the Search tab (it shows a clearable chip).
- Fix: clear `diff`/`diffList` (and `searchPath`) when `scope.rootId` or the changes source changes. Alternatively, store the scope key with the diff target and ignore a mismatched target.

### [correctness] A deleted, uncommitted file shows an error instead of a deletion diff — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/dock/changes/DockDiffView.tsx:105`
- Severity: ~
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect (edge case B-D7 does not name); in_pr_scope
- Trigger and changed-code connection: Changes tab → a "Not committed yet" row for a file deleted in the working tree (RootChangesList and ProjectMainChangesList list every git-status entry, including `deleted`; conversation `uncommitted` can list a deleted file) → Open diff → `DockDiffView` calls `readFile(rootId, target.path)` for the working copy outside any try. The server's `read.ts:152` throws `NOT_FOUND` for a missing file.
- Expected / observed / impact: expected the HEAD content diffed against nothing (the mirror of the new-file case the code already handles for a missing HEAD). Observed: "Couldn't load this diff: "<path>" does not exist". The operator cannot see what was deleted from the dock; the rest of the dock works.
- Evidence: static trace of `DockDiffView.tsx` lines 104-117 and `src/dashboard/server/services/explorer/read.ts:152`; not reproduced in a browser.
- Fix: wrap the working-copy read like the HEAD read: on `NOT_FOUND` use `''` as the working contents (or pass the git status `deleted` flag in `DockDiffTarget` and skip the read).

### [requirements] An edit-workspace "Committed on <branch>" row opens an empty diff — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/dock/changes/RootChangesList.tsx:71`
- Severity: ~
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect against an explicit non-goal; in_pr_scope
- Trigger and changed-code connection: Changes tab on a `workspace:` root whose `gitStatus.committed` is non-empty (`git.ts:119` `committedSinceDefault` fills it for edit-workspace branches) → Open diff on a committed row. `RootChangesList` marks the row `committedVsMain: true`; `DockDiffView.tsx:99` handles that only when the root is an issue, so a workspace root falls through to the HEAD-versus-working-copy path. For a file with no uncommitted edit that diff is empty.
- Expected / observed / impact: §6.4 says an edit-workspace root has no committed diff (non-goal; the row keeps Open beside / Reveal). Observed: the row offers Open diff, and the view shows an empty file diff tagged "committed on the branch", which suggests the commit changed nothing.
- Evidence: static trace; not reproduced in a browser.
- Fix: for a non-issue root with `committedVsMain`, show a sentence such as "Diffs of committed files are not available for edit workspaces", or hide Open diff on those rows.

### [requirements] FR-7 "+/−" relies on the FileDiff header — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/dock/changes/DockDiffView.tsx:150`
- Severity: ?
- Classification: unconfirmed hypothesis
- The dock's own diff header row shows back, the path, i/N, previous/next, the tag, Open beside and Reveal, but no +/− counts. `PatchFiles` renders `@pierre/diffs` `FileDiff` with its default file header, which normally shows line counts, so FR-7 is likely met through that header. A screenshot of the diff view, or a test that asserts the counts, would settle it.

### [performance] Several subscriptions to the same conversation-changes query
- Severity: ? (advisory)
- `WorkDock`, `FilesTab`, `SearchTab`, `DockQuickOpen` and `useChangesCount` each call `useConversationChanges` for the same key, and each subscribes `useExplorerWatch` on the root while enabled. React Query dedupes the fetch, and the watch hub shares the stream, so one watch batch causes several invalidations but one request. No material impact at realistic scale.

# Review — PAN-5289
## Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED — the Reveal fix re-applies a stale `reveal` after every scope change, so the dock stops following the active tab (it writes a root override that B-D17 forbids)

## Context
- Run ID: agent-pan-5289-review-fd1e267c
- Manifest: .pan/review/agent-pan-5289-review-fd1e267c/context.json (acceptanceCriteria empty; ACs from `.pan/drafts/pan-5289.md` §9)
- Branch / workspace: feature/pan-5289 / workspaces/feature-pan-5289
- PR: https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/pull/5328
- HEAD reviewed: fd1e267c0cbeb877c0c566f5bd4d4540638e521a
- Base / prior cycle SHA: prior cycle reviewed f89f29e9606 (run agent-pan-5289-review-f89f29e9, CHANGES REQUESTED). The new commits are `d568cf0136c` (the fix), `cfb3efcac69` (plan bookkeeping) and `fd1e267c0cb` (a merge of origin/main). The merge brings PAN-5316/PAN-5325 files that are outside this PR's scope and do not touch any PAN-5289 file.

## Prior findings: verification
| Prior finding | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| ! Reveal in files never reveals | **fixed, with a new regression (below)** | `FilesTab.tsx` now reads `byDeck[deck].reveal` and calls `explorerStore.revealPath`. The new `ExplorerPane.test.tsx` "FilesTab Reveal in files" cases select a real tree row with its folder expanded. |
| ~ Stale diff / searchPath after a scope change | fixed | `WorkDock.tsx` scope-key effect → `workDockStore.clearScopedState`; WorkDock test "drops an open diff and a Search folder when the scope changes" |
| ~ Deleted uncommitted file errors | fixed | `DockDiffView.tsx` wraps the working-copy read; NOT_FOUND → `''`; test added |
| ~ Edit-workspace committed row shows an empty diff | fixed | `DockDiffView.tsx` `NO_WORKSPACE_COMMIT_DIFF` for `committedVsMain && !issueId`; test added |
| ? FR-7 +/− | accepted | the author reports seeing the FileDiff header counts in the browser run; not blocking |

## Blocking Findings

### [correctness] A stale `reveal` writes a root override on later tab changes, so the dock stops following the active tab — `src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/dock/FilesTab.tsx:29`
- Severity: !
- Classification / requirement scope: implementation defect introduced by `d568cf0136c`. in_pr_scope: it breaks FR-2 (the scope follows the active Stage tab) and violates B-D17 verbatim: "No effect writes or clears it on tab changes".
- Trigger and changed-code connection: the new effect in `FilesTab` runs on `[deckKey, reveal, rootId, openSeq]`. When `reveal.rootId !== scope.rootId` it calls `setRootOverride(deckKey, reveal.rootId, anchor)`. Nothing ever clears `reveal`: `openDock` replaces it only when the next `openDock` comes, and `setTab`, `closeDock` and `clearScopedState` keep it. So after any Reveal, the next active-tab change to a different root makes `rootId` differ from the old `reveal.rootId`, and the effect writes an override. It does this either while `FilesTab` is mounted, or when the operator next picks the Files tab. The anchor comes from `useActiveDock.getState().current?.activePaneId`. Child effects run before `WorkDock`'s activeDock effect, so while Files is showing that is still the *previous* pane id.
- Expected / observed / impact: the dock should keep following the active tab after a Reveal. I reproduced this with an isolated probe that mounts the real `WorkDock` and `FilesTab`, with ExplorerFiles stubbed:
  - **A.** On an issue tab, Reveal (store `reveal` = `issue:PAN-9`), switch to Changes, activate Home, then pick Files. The dock shows `issue:PAN-9` on Home, with a sticky override `{rootOverride: "issue:PAN-9", anchor: "home"}`. Home's own files are hidden until the operator clicks Follow tab.
  - **B.** On an issue tab, Reveal, then activate Home with Files showing. An override anchored to the old issue pane is written (`{o: "issue:PAN-9", a: "i1"}`). Back on the issue tab, the scope line reads "Issue PAN-9 · Fix the gate" plus a **Follow tab** button that the operator never asked for.
  - **D.** On a conversation tab, Reveal `project:p/src/a.ts` (what a conversation Changes-row Reveal does), activate an issue tab, then return to the conversation. The scope line changes from "For Fix the bug · Project P · main" to "Project Project P · main checkout · Follow tab". Rule 1 now maps the override to `project-main`, so the Changes tab loses that conversation's changes, and the Files tab loses "Only what this conversation changed", until the operator clicks Follow tab.

  Reveal is a frequent action, so after one Reveal the dock silently stops following tabs.
- Evidence: runtime reproduction. The probe is `reveal.probe.test.tsx` with `vitest.probe.config.mts`, under the session scratchpad `…/scratchpad/probe/`. It runs against the frontend vitest config, and its recorded output is `result.txt` in the same folder:
  ```
  A: files root on Home = issue:PAN-9 store = {"o":"issue:PAN-9","a":"home"}
  B: files root on Home = project:p store = {"o":"issue:PAN-9","a":"i1"}
  B: back on issue tab, scope line = Issue PAN-9 · Fix the gate Follow tab
  D: before = For Fix the bug · Project P · main
  D: after = Project Project P · main checkout Follow tab store="project:p"
  ```
  The committed tests miss this because each renders `FilesTab` once, with a fixed scope, and never changes the active pane after a Reveal.
- Fix: make a reveal a one-shot request tied to the `openDock` call that made it. Pick one of these:
  - clear `reveal` once it is handled (a `clearReveal(deckKey)` action called from the effect after `revealPath`);
  - track the handled `openSeq` in a ref and act only when `openSeq` is new;
  - include `reveal` in `clearScopedState` and do the cross-root override only in the same `openSeq` the reveal arrived with.

  Take the anchor from the active pane the dock was given (pass `activePane?.paneId` into `FilesTab`), not from `activeDock`, which lags by one effect. Add a WorkDock-level test: Reveal, change `activePane` to a pane on another root, assert `rootOverride` stays undefined and the scope follows the new pane; then return and assert there is no Follow tab.

## Non-blocking Findings
None new. Every advisory from the prior cycle is fixed (see above).

## Coverage

### Changed-file ledger
- Cycle-1 ledger (97 files) stands as recorded in `.pan/review/agent-pan-5289-review-f89f29e9/review.md`. Those files are unchanged since f89f29e except the fix commit's files below.
- Re-reviewed in this cycle (`d568cf0136c`):
  - `dock/FilesTab.tsx`: the blocker.
  - `dock/WorkDock.tsx`: the scope-key effect is correct. It clears `diff`/`diffList`/`searchPath` only on a real scope change.
  - `dock/workDockStore.ts`: `clearScopedState` is correct, and it is a no-op when there is nothing to clear.
